g.text: 150 stores · ~30 cameras each · 4,500+ concurrent streams · sub-second inference at the edge
camera → decode → detect → track → rule → event → GCP → operator acts → label → retrain
edge pipeline — decode never touches the CPU
an event needs a zone, dwell time and
you page a human 400 times a night.
if you shipped the video. you don't.
what crosses the wire is ~2 KB of JSON
and one 6 s clip, only when something
the clip is cut from a ring buffer —
event + clip · HTTPS, retried on the appliance
what actually crosses the wire (~2 KB)
per-store policy, not a global threshold
the only human in the loop
loss numbers, not a benchmark set.
the operator is the labeller — that is the whole data strategy
an engine is built per GPU model.
there is no single binary that ships
to all 150 stores — this cost us weeks
deciding what to retrain ON is not —
the operator clicks are the only
ground truth anyone ever gave us.
Rafael De Santis · rasantis.github.io · built and operated solo, edge to cloud
